title: GET /api/offers/guide — the sell-side versioned guide
description: Public, unauthenticated sell-side guide at GET /api/offers/guide. offersGuide() (src/offers.ts) ALWAYS serves rules_version, changed_at, read_this_first, who_pays, for_sellers, for_buyers, what_an_offer_is_not, rule, and check_it_yourself; the router's json() wrapper adds now / now_utc. All prose fields are server-authored: Presence/stringness is the contract; wording is not pinned. check_it_yourself always carries who, offers, provenance, and the_hash. Twin of the buy-side rail guide at GET /api/listings/guide (which this document points at). Soft-power / cloudymcclouder. No overlap with Cloudy #301 (listings/guide who_pays content fix), #302 (offers list), #320 (offers/:id), or babysit #313/#314/#315/#319/#324. Unowned after the surface∩schemas∩open-PR sweep of 2026-09-20.

now.description: Server time, ms epoch — added by the router's json() wrapper.

now_utc.description: Server time as UTC ISO-8601 — added by the router's json() wrapper.

rules_version.description: OFFERS_GUIDE_VERSION. Bumps with OFFERS_GUIDE_CHANGED_AT whenever any served rule in offersGuide() changes. Shape only; the value is not pinned.

changed_at.description: OFFERS_GUIDE_CHANGED_AT. Companion stamp to rules_version. Shape only; the value is not pinned.

read_this_first.description: Server-authored pointer at /api/listings/guide as the rail. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

who_pays.description: Server-authored who-pays sentence for the sell side. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

for_sellers.description: Server-authored steps for sellers. Always a non-empty string array; wording is not pinned.

for_buyers.description: Server-authored steps for buyers. Always a non-empty string array; wording is not pinned.

what_an_offer_is_not.description: Server-authored negative-space list. Always a non-empty string array; wording is not pinned.

rule.description: OFFER_RULE prose. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

checkItYourself.description: Four always-present server-authored verification pointers (who / offers / provenance / the_hash). Presence and stringness are the contract; wording is not. the_hash is how a stranger recomputes the committed price from payload_hash_recipe.

who.description: Who can check — always auth:none. Presence pinned; wording is not.

offers.description: How to read GET /api/offers. Presence pinned; wording is not.

provenance.description: How to read GET /api/offers/:id for order→listing provenance. Presence pinned; wording is not.

the_hash.description: How payload_hash / payload_hash_recipe make the committed price checkable. Presence pinned; wording is not.
